question: Who among the following was **NOT** one of the recipients of the US military decoration 'the Legion of Merit' in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is__** **____**Boris Johnson**__.

__
 
• **Boris Johnson** was **not one of the recipients of the US military decoratio**n** 'the Legion of Merit in December 2020.​​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The Legion of Merit is a **military award of the United States Armed Forces** that is given for exceptionally meritorious conduct in the **performance of outstanding services and achievements**.
 
• The Legion of Merit, in the **highest degree of the Chief Commander**, is a prestigious award conferred by the President of the United States, typically upon **Heads of State or Heads of Government of other countries**.
